people.name: Meribah
people.line: A place where Moses disobeyed God

translations.web: You called in trouble, and I delivered you. I answered you in the secret place of thunder. I tested you at the waters of Meribah.”
translations.bsb: You called out in distress, and I rescued you; I answered you from the cloud of thunder; I tested you at the waters of Meribah. Selah
translations.kjv: Thou calledst in trouble, and I delivered thee; I answered thee in the secret place of thunder: I proved thee at the waters of Meribah. Selah.
translations.asv: Thou calledst in trouble, and I delivered thee; I answered thee in the secret place of thunder; I proved thee at the waters of Meribah. Selah
